Off-Plan
The real estate developer will build and develop your residential unit in the future, committing to execute it according to the agreed models, specifications, and timeline, within a maximum period of 36 months. The product is available to customers of the Real Estate Development Fund.
Apply Now
Off-Plan Sale

Finance to purchase property villa or apartment to be built or semi-built by ARB approved developer in a maximum of 36 months, the product is available for REDF customers and alrajhi bank customers.

Ability to obtain financing with tenure up to 360 months.
APR starts from 5.96%
the ability to increase / control the DBR% to enable raising the financing amount up to 75%.
Flexible repayment plan starting from  400 per month for the first 3 years.
Possibility of financing the down payment without interest over a period of 3 years.
Completing your ﬁnance request in a timely manner.
Enabling the customers to benefit from other financing products and services provided by ARB.
Retiree customers are included in the awareness campaign
The possibility of financing non-Saudi customers who hold a premium residency.
Early Settlement is available at any time upon customer's request.
Guarantor is not required to have a personal ﬁnance.
Finance amount is up to  5 m.
Exemption of Finance Amount in case of passing away (God Forbid).
Terms and Required documents
A statement of salary transfer

A statement of salary transfer from employer ( in case financed with salary transfer)

Declaration form

Monthly expense declaration form

Valid national ID or premium residency ID
Providing price by Al Rajhi Bank

Providing price quotation for the unit desired from one of the approved projects by alrajhi bank

Salary certificate from employer
Saudi nationality or expat with premium residency ID
Minimum service 3 months
Salary starts from  5,000 for salary transfer and  7,000 for non-salary transfer
